items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have a snare drum that he made for me. ... Billy Gladstone came in to hear me play. ... He said, 'I’m going to make a snare drum for you.'

ctx.x: How about going back and looking at some of the classic drum teachers: Billy Gladstone. Did you know him?

Yeah. Billy Gladstone. I have a snare drum that he made for me. It’s a solid maple shell, three-ways key. You tighten everything at the top, nothing from the bottom. Beautiful hand drum. It’s now in a museum, somewhere up here in San Francisco. I can’t thing of the guy – an Italian guy, got it from me. It starts with an F. I’ll think of his name too. He collects snare drums.
I know who you’re talking about, but his name doesn’t come to mind either.
